Update done, seems like everything went well even though there was a charging process started midupdate. The outlet that had the charging session is again charging properly - so no problem.
Now, for DC1 we have TempError:
Check from the cable if you see this value and if yes, replace the cable. If no, then please measure until the StateMonitor and check if replacing the grey connector or the StateMonitor fixes it.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
